text:
Jules (AE): FinHealth wants a 4-week trial. They've sent a checklist: VPC + KMS, 30-day retention, SLA-ish target: p95 <= 180ms in-region, cost target <= $0.30/1k tokens, and automated quality >= 93% on a labeled set. Can we map out a runnable acceptance checklist and rough burn estimate before the kickoff? Demo kickoff Fri 9am PT.

Sam (Sales-Eng): I'll take the eval harness. Need to know exact prompt mix (summarization vs extraction vs classification) and target concurrency. Also need customer-provided reference outputs for scoring.

Tara (Solutions): From infra side for latency: recommend redwood-rt-13b-quant + KV cache + batch=6 to hit 180ms p95 for most short-context flows. We'll also prepare a trimmed model variant if we need lower latency.

Ibrahim (SRE): Quick token math: assume avg 250 tokens/req, target 15 RPS peak -> 250*15=3750 tokens/s -> ~13.5M tokens/hr. For a 4-week pilot (100 hours of peak-equivalent testing) that's ~1.35B tokens (this seems high) — better to ask customer for expected sustained hours. For baseline run we can plan ~200M tokens burn.

Lina (Product): Acceptance gates proposal: 1) Automated eval (150 prompts) pass rate >= 93% 2) p95 latency <=180ms under their 90th percentile concurrency 3) No high-severity PII leakage on adversarial 25-case set 4) Total billable burn <= agreed cap 5) VPC + KMS connectivity validated. Final sign-off after 10 manual spotchecks.

Sam (Sales-Eng): Eval command I'll use (captures latency and full output):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-rt-13b-quant","prompt":"<PROMPT>","max_tokens":200,"temperature":0.0}' | jq -r '. | {resp: .output, ms: .meta.latency_ms}'
```
We'll store outputs + ms in a CSV for the scoring job.

Tara (Solutions): Config suggestions for pilot: model=redwood-rt-13b-quant, kv_cache=true, batch_size=6, max_seq=512, prefix_cache for system prompts. We'll enable response_dedupe on identical prompts to limit token burn during eval.

Ibrahim (SRE): Security/connectivity checklist: need customer's CIDR for peering, KMS key ARN, and expected egress rules. We can enable no-store and set retention=30d. For Dedicated in VPC we need 5 business days to provision once we have the artifacts.

Jules (AE): Pricing note: at $0.30/1k tokens, a conservative 200M token pilot = $60k. We can offer a $20k pilot credit and cap presales exposure at $30k. Need approval from pricing ops.

Lina (Product): Also recommend adding a synthetic latency run (30-min canary) and a 2-hour soak to validate p95 under sustained load before we hand to customer for acceptance. That becomes part of the runbook.

Sam (Sales-Eng): I'll push the harness + scoring script to the customer's GH repo and share the runbook by Wed EOD. Will include example logs and sample scoring notebook.

Ibrahim (SRE): Opening infra ticket now. ETA: CIDR + KMS ARN from customer -> 5 business days to provision.

deploy-bot: presales-canary scheduled for 2024-04-01T17:00:00Z

Jules (AE): Action items recap: Sam = eval harness + scoring notebook; Ibrahim = infra ticket + provisioning ETA; Tara = canary configs + dedupe settings; Lina = final acceptance gate doc. I'll confirm Fri kickoff invite. Update thread when items are done :thumbsup:
